query: What preprocessing parameters and temporal-alignment procedures are required for simultaneous MR-EEG-pupillometry (gradient template length, BCG correction method, eye-tracker calibration, lighting controls)?

response.query: What preprocessing parameters and temporal-alignment procedures are required for simultaneous MR-EEG-pupillometry (gradient template length, BCG correction method, eye-tracker calibration, lighting controls)?
response.answer: Gradient template length should be 1-2 seconds; BCG correction uses a linear regression model; eye-tracker calibration requires 5-10 minutes; lighting should be dimmed to 20 lux.
